messages.subject: Clearing Simmer memory during simulation
parts:
Is it possible to clear Simmer's memory during the simulation?

I'm monitoring a lot of resources for which I store information ((during simulation) in a separate dataframe. I want to avoid get_mon_resources(env) to get too large.

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Clearing Simmer memory during simulation
parts:
On Thu, 7 May 2020 at 15:50, Eras <j.e...@student.tue.nl> wrote:
>
> Is it possible to clear Simmer's memory during the simulation?
> I'm monitoring a lot of resources for which I store information ((during simulation) in a separate dataframe. I want to avoid get_mon_resources(env) to get too large.

One of the main ideas behind simmer is that you don't need to build
your own monitoring data structures, because all the changes about
arrivals, resources and attributes are automatically recorded. So I
wouldn't recommend that (it makes your simulation much slower too).

That said, if you implement your own monitoring, then you can just
switch off simmer's monitoring capabilities: resources and sources
have a "mon" argument that you can set to FALSE.

--
